run_update_version: run the script to update protobuf version across all language build files with a new version number
update_cpp_version: update C++ header files with new protobuf version defines and version suffix values
update_java_pom: update Java Maven pom.xml files with a new protobuf release version number
update_configure_ac: update the configure.ac autotools file with a new Protocol Buffers version string
update_php_package: update the PHP protobuf package.xml with new version, date, stability, and changelog entries
